title: Praise Him All Day
video_prompt: Cocomelon 3D style, a happy baby lamb jumping and clapping in a bright green field with balloons and confetti, sunny sky, extremely colourful and energetic, party vibe for toddlers, 16:9.
music_prompt: High-energy toddler praise song 'Praise Him All Day', drums, hand claps, bright brass stabs, excited kids choir shouting praise, 120 bpm.

lyrics.text: Clap your hands and praise His name,
Jesus loves us all the same.
Jump up high and shout hooray,
We will praise Him all the day!
